tools.name: site_info
tools.description: Orientation: who Mash Prime is, what the site covers, when to use it, and every page — returned as markdown (the site's llms.txt).

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List all published blog posts with slug, title, description, and publication date, newest first.

tools.name: read_post
tools.description: Read the full markdown text of one blog post by slug (get slugs from list_posts).

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search blog posts across titles, descriptions, and full text, ranked best match first. Returns matching posts with the most relevant passage as a snippet.

tools.name: related_posts
tools.description: Posts closest in meaning to a given post, by similarity of their text embeddings, most similar first. Use to follow a thread of ideas from one post to the next.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, read_post, search_posts · Public sink: read_post, related_posts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_posts, read_post, search_posts · Public sink: read_post, related_posts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
